notes.text: You can now hide the Summarize button either at the application level or the object page level by configuring the hideSummarizationButton setting in the manifest.json file
We've resolved an issue where the message popover failed to open on the first click when a table on the object page contained columns bound to navigation property paths
We've resolved an issue in the analytical table where clicking a SmartLink inside an expanded row didn't open the popover with navigation links
We now correctly display the Related Apps button on the object page when it is opened using cross-app navigation or a direct URL
We've resolved an issue where filter values were not restored correctly from a variant that contained default values when the user refreshed the page, navigated back, or opened an app tile
We've resolved an issue where cross-app navigation stopped working after the first successful navigation when the target application opened in a new browser tab
We've resolved an issue where a missing translation file caused repeated 404 requests and slowed down the Adaptation Editor in SAP Business Application Studio
We now ensure that the AI-assisted easy filter loads correctly for filter fields with a fixed value list that originate from a navigation property
